efbAircraft.title: Cockpit EFB aircraft patches
efbAircraft.introLine1: Patch all selectable presets of selected aircraft with the 3d movable tablet.
efbAircraft.introLine2: Separate Community overlay packages replace existing tablets without editing source aircraft files on disk.
efbAircraft.modeStandardDesc: Standard scans unpacked Community aircraft; no running simulator required.
efbAircraft.modeDeepDesc: Deep scans aircraft exposed through VFS projection. Keep MSFS running with Developer Mode and VFS projection enabled. Mounted overlays may mask underlying stock updates.
efbAircraft.scanNoteLine2: Source hashes detect simulator updates. Rescan and Apply to regenerate outdated patches.
efbAircraft.careerNoticeLine1: Career mode: the simulator excludes any patched aircraft from Career missions.
efbAircraft.careerNoticeLine2: Remove the aircraft patches and restart MSFS before playing Career; the 2D EFB keeps working in Career.
efbAircraft.careerRiskWarningOne: Career mode warning: patching {{aircraft}} can make the entire Career mode unavailable, beyond the simulator excluding patched aircraft from Career missions. Leave this aircraft unpatched if you use Career mode.
efbAircraft.careerRiskWarningMany: Career mode warning: patching {{aircraft}} can make the entire Career mode unavailable, beyond the simulator excluding patched aircraft from Career missions. Leave these aircraft unpatched if you use Career mode.

embedServer.title: Embed server
embedServer.descriptionLine1: The embed server is required when opening the EFB via an external device or web browser.
embedServer.descriptionLine2: Additionally, even when accessing the EFB directly within the app, it must be launched to ensure synchronization with the simulator.

step1.title: 1. Enable Developer Mode
step1.description: In MSFS, open Settings > General > Advanced Options and enable Developer Mode.
step1.alt: General settings: select Advanced Options, then check Developer Mode

step2.title: 2. Open Virtual File System
step2.description: From the developer toolbar at the top, choose Tools > Virtual File System.
step2.alt: Developer toolbar: open Tools and choose Virtual File System

step3.title: 3. Start projection
step3.description: In the VFS Projector section, click Start. Wait for Projection started. Keep MSFS running; Deep scanning becomes available automatically.
step3.alt: VFS Projector: click Start and wait for Projection started
